name: Circle of the Sea Spells
description: When you reach a Druid level specified in the Circle of the Sea Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared. Level 3 - Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Ray of Frost, Thunderwave. Level 5 - Lightning Bolt, Water Breathing. Level 7 - Control Water, Ice Storm. Level 9 - Conjure Elemental, Hold Monster.

review.notes: authored from PHB 2024, mechanic not yet wired to activities
